completion_contract: Return source-established facts separately from bounded engineering inferences.
Return source hashes and locators for every material fact.
Preserve unresolved conflicts instead of silently reconciling them.
State which retrieval requirements are satisfied, unavailable, or still blocked.
State whether evidence is sufficient for a fresh Architecture Innovator role.
If insufficient, identify only the exact remaining evidence gaps and next lawful capability.
governing_boundaries: Do not select or implement a shared-inference architecture.
Do not approve, reject, repair, or mutate the current GPU candidate.
Do not mutate GPU, Ollama, Kubernetes, host, repository, Git, or lifecycle state.
Do not copy historical MicroK8s mechanics into Kalaxy3/K3s design.
Do not invent missing Architect-owned serving requirements.
Preserve source provenance, hashes, evidence maturity, and unresolved conflicts.
objective: Retrieve only the missing evidence required to make safe architecture innovation possible for the machine-neutral shared Kalaxy-hosted inference endpoint.

retrieval_requirements.need: Original Kalaxy2 Ollama, vLLM, OpenWebUI, LLM setup, serving, monitoring, and fine-tuning page contents.
retrieval_requirements.required_evidence: Original source bytes or equivalent authoritative content with path, provenance, content hash, and relevant locators.
retrieval_requirements.stop_condition: The role can state what Kalaxy2 actually implemented, selected, observed, and learned without inferring from an index.

retrieval_requirements.need: Current authoritative GPU identity, VRAM, and accepted end-to-end GPU qualification state for amd64-01 and amd64-02.
retrieval_requirements.required_evidence: Existing trusted live evidence covering driver, container runtime/toolkit, K3s integration, nvidia.com/gpu exposure, and successful workload execution. If such evidence does not already exist, report the gap without mutating runtime.
retrieval_requirements.stop_condition: Current capacity and qualification can be distinguished from stale declarations and untrusted candidate state.

retrieval_requirements.need: Architect-owned serving workload requirements for target models or model classes, quantization expectations, context length, concurrency, and latency/throughput priorities.
retrieval_requirements.required_evidence: Existing Architect intent or authoritative current SAGE usage profile. Missing values remain explicit decision surfaces rather than inferred defaults.
retrieval_requirements.stop_condition: Architecture alternatives can be evaluated against explicit workload requirements, or the exact missing Architect decision is isolated.

retrieval_requirements.need: Current storage and endpoint access/security constraints for model persistence and machine-neutral workstation access.
retrieval_requirements.required_evidence: Current storage classes/capacity/performance plus network, ingress, TLS/authentication, trust-boundary, and workstation reachability evidence.
retrieval_requirements.stop_condition: Persistence and endpoint alternatives can be compared without invented storage or security assumptions.
